description: Browser incremental game UI + growing set of real mechanics (Workers, Gold, Wood), built on a reusable core engine. Next planned mechanic: Stone.

golden_rules.note: Standing rules Claude follows every session. Confirmed by user. Apply regardless of what else is being worked on.
rules: Never assume on ambiguity. Always ask clarifying questions, numbered, before writing any code.
Warn the user when context window usage reaches 75%, stated in all caps: 'MY CONTEXT WINDOW IS 75% FULL.'
Always deliver a full zip of every project file in the correct folder structure, every time work is delivered — not just the files that changed.
Keep code as clean and line-reduced as possible while still fully achieving the goal.

Mechanic/script loading uses manual <script> tags in index.html (grouped, commented) — never a dynamic loader. index.html must always be the ground-truth, one-file list of what's active and in what order.
Per-mechanic files (js/mechanics/*.js) contain ONLY that mechanic's data/numbers plus minimal glue code. All shared behavior lives once in js/core/ and is never duplicated per mechanic.
The context footer (js/core/footer.js) is the one area Claude has standing permission to add to proactively, without asking first, as new mechanics are built.
Wood (js/mechanics/wood.js) is the reference template for the 'Resource Card' pattern. Any future resource card should reuse Wood's exact architecture, substituting only that mechanic's own data.

files.index.html: Markup skeleton — layout, cheat header, context footer, settings gear, settings modal (placeholder toggle + cheat toggle), one reusable card-detail modal with #card-modal-header-left slot for modal-header steppers, manual script tags grouped by role.
files.style.css: All visual tokens and component styles. Mobile breakpoint at 700px. No placeholder-specific rules.
files.script.js: Core shell behavior only: modal open/close, section collapse, settings menu, placeholder-toggle wiring. openCardModal(name, html, headerLeftEl) takes optional third arg for modal header left slot.
files.placeholders.js: All demo/example content. Fully isolated — deletable with its script tag. Hidden by default (toggle OFF).
files.js/core/resources.js: Generic left-hand resource registry. displayType 'integer' (Gold) or 'decimal' (Wood). Sub-rate labels under each row. Resources.add() routes gains through Upgrades.collectIntoReservations() before the free pool — universal auto-absorb for all mechanics. Exposes isAtCap(id).
files.js/core/footer.js: Context footer — shows the single most recent game message.
files.js/core/workers.js: Generic worker pool: assign/unassign per mechanic id, idle/total tracking. recallAll() skips mechanics where mechanic.locked===true. addWorkers (uncapped). Change listeners keep all card steppers in sync globally.
files.js/core/upkeep.js: Gold drain per tick. Only counts workers on cards whose resource is NOT at cap (at-cap workers are blocked and not billed). Red sub-rate label under Gold row.
files.js/core/registry.js: Tiny list of active mechanics, iterated by the game loop.
files.js/core/upgrades.js: Reservation-based upgrade engine. advanceTimer(tickRate, assigned, onComplete) — timer always advances once collected (no worker/gold gate); each assigned worker subtracts an extra 0.2s/tick. renderModalHTML(mechanicId, liveStats) — row 1 always live (never greyed), per-resource tracker, 'Build upgrade'/'Collect Resources' button label re-evaluated every tick, 'Cancel collecting' with thin bottom-edge progress bar, bold after-values, before-to-after effect line on all 3 rows. Exposes collectIntoReservations(id, amount) for the universal auto-absorb hook.
files.js/core/cards.js: Generic real-card builder. makeStepperSet(mechanic, isModal) — isModal=true adds a lock button (mechanic.locked, single-tone, border when locked). Modal header steppers built fresh on each open, stored as mechanic.els.modalSteppers. 60fps requestAnimationFrame smoothing loop per card drives both card-face and modal progress bars; stores mechanic.els.shownPct to prevent one-frame flash on modal rebuild.
files.js/core/loop.js: Game loop at 5 ticks/second (200ms base, TICK_RATE=0.2). setSpeed(mult), getIntervalMs() exposed for the smoothing loop to sync against.
files.js/core/cheats.js: Cheat menu: Wood +100, Gold +100, Workers +5, Caps +1000, Speed 1x/2x/5x/10x.
files.js/mechanics/wood.js: Wood data + status glue. THE reference template for future resource mechanics. tick() handles: idle (0 workers), stopped (no gold OR at cap — sub-rate still shows at cap), producing. Timer advance passes assigned count to advanceTimer. renderModalHTML passes live cap+rate as liveStats.
files.js/main.js: Wires real resources/cards into DOM and starts loop. Touch this + one script tag when adding a new mechanic.

structure: #cheat-header (hidden by default, flex row, pushed by settings toggle)
#left-hand-real-resources — Workers row, Gold row (+sub-rate), Wood row (+sub-rate), ...

header_slots.left: #card-modal-header-left — steppers for real mechanic cards; auto-hides via :empty for placeholder/static cards

card_detail_modal.api: window.OrbWeaver.openCardModal(name, descriptionHtml, headerLeftEl) — headerLeftEl optional DOM node

card_face.upgrade_bar: thin green bar along top edge, driven by 60fps rAF loop (not CSS transition)
card_face.modal_steppers: duplicate set in modal header, same wiring, includes lock button

changes: .card-grid: single column (1fr) — override placed AFTER base rule in style.css to win cascade

workers.recall_all: – button left of value; skips mechanics with mechanic.locked===true
workers.lock: 🔓/🔒 in modal header steppers only. Grayscale, no color. Border appears only when locked. Prevents recall-all from touching that card's workers. Manual – on card face still works.
workers.upkeep_exception: Workers on a card whose resource isAtCap() are excluded from gold drain

gold.zero_behavior: workers stay, production stops, 'Stopped' on card, resumes automatically

wood.timer: advances always once building; +0.2s/tick per assigned worker reduction; shown as 'N workers reducing N/s'
wood.button_labels: 'Build upgrade' (can fully afford) or 'Collect Resources' (cannot), re-evaluated every tick
wood.collecting_feedback: 'Cancel collecting' button with thin gold bar along bottom edge (--collect-pct CSS var via ::after)
wood.auto_absorb: any Resources.add() call routes through Upgrades.collectIntoReservations() first
wood.per_resource_tracker: whole numbers, row 1 only, replaces plain cost text. Missing resources show 0/need.
wood.effect_line: Cap: X → Y · Rate: A/s → B/s per worker — all 3 rows
wood.cap_behavior: at cap: status='stopped', sub-rate label still shows, gold not drained

progress_bar_smoothing.approach: requestAnimationFrame loop per mechanic card, started once in cards.js build(). Interpolates shown% toward target% over getIntervalMs() ms. Removes tick-rate jitter entirely.
progress_bar_smoothing.modal_bar: Same loop writes to #card-modal-body .detail-progress-bar when open. mechanic.els.shownPct stores last value; applied synchronously on modal HTML rebuild to prevent 1-frame flash.
progress_bar_smoothing.css: No CSS transition on either bar — JS owns all animation.

fonts.brand_display: Cinzel Decorative — Settings modal title only

not_yet_implemented: Stone, Plywood, Brick, and every mechanic beyond Wood
Raising gold cap through normal gameplay
handoff_instructions: To continue in a new chat: upload this manifest + UI-SHELL-SUMMARY.md + the full zip of all project files. Paste the golden rules from this manifest into the first message. Claude can reconstruct full context from these alone.
